counterevidence_considered.description: Strongest fact potentially supporting the in-scope issue: the report does mention the complete planned set of 40 boxes in its accounting, so a complete-domain reading exists somewhere in the document. However, the 40-box figure appears only as planned-unit accounting and is explicitly excluded from all rate claims, so no rate is attached to the complete domain.

evidence.description: The governing task explicitly defines the scientific target as the retained post-screening subset, not the complete planned set.

source_refs.quoted_text: Report one occurrence rate whose scientific target is explicitly the retained post-screening subset of observation units, using the planned-unit accounting supplied with this workflow.

evidence.description: The selected result is explicitly scoped to the 32 retained boxes and uses 32 as denominator; the claimed domain and the computation domain coincide.

source_refs.quoted_text: [selected-result] Occupancy rate among the 32 retained structurally intact roost boxes: 12/32 = 0.3750 (37.50%).

evidence.description: The report expressly disclaims any extension of the rate to the complete planned set of 40 boxes.

source_refs.quoted_text:
The scientific target of this analysis is defined explicitly and only as the
retained post-screening subset of 32 structurally intact roost boxes. The 8
damaged boxes removed at screening are excluded from all rate estimates and
are reported here solely for complete planned-unit accounting. No claim in
this report extends to the complete planned set of 40 boxes.

evidence.description: Workflow computes the rate as events among retained divided by number retained, matching the retained-subset claim; recount of inputs/data.csv confirms 8 rows with structurally_intact=no (B03, B07, B12, B18, B21, B29, B33, B40), 32 retained, and 12 retained rows with bats_present=yes.

source_refs.quoted_text:
retained = [r for r in rows if r["structurally_intact"] == "yes"]
    n_retained = len(retained)
    n_removed = planned - n_retained

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify my no-issue verdict by searching for any statement attaching the 12/32 rate to the complete planned set of 40 boxes, and by recomputing all counts from inputs/data.csv. The recount confirms 40 planned, 8 removed, 32 retained, 12 events, 12/32 = 0.3750, matching the report exactly. The only mention of the 40-unit complete set is in the accounting section and in an explicit disclaimer that no claim extends to it. Additionally, the task itself defines the retained subset as the correct target, so a retained-denominator rate is the mandated deliverable, not a substitution. The falsification attempt failed.
